# Pricing

The tier is priced at a premium over the existing plan to reflect the added value.

## Strategy

Position the tier as the natural upgrade path for power users.

## Tactics

- Announce at the next product update
- Offer a limited early-adopter discount

# Rollout

## Strategy

Roll out in two phases: beta cohort first, then general availability.

## Risks and Mitigation

| Risk | Mitigation |
| --- | --- |
| Low uptake | Early-adopter pricing |
| Support load | Dedicated onboarding docs |

# Success Metrics

## Strategy

Measure weekly active subscribers and net revenue retention.

## Tactics

- Track conversion from trial
- Track churn after the first month
